findings.claim: API estimator passes API.Queryable and configured global scrape interval. Standard web API receives handler storage; server wiring previously frozen provides fanout storage.
findings.limit: Existing selected standard server wiring, not arbitrary custom API/queryable configurations.

findings.claim: Estimator counts series through ordinary queryable independently of optional sampling capability; fanout opens primary and secondary queriers. Remote storage builds client queriers and merges them.
findings.limit: No actual remote call made; required-matcher guard may make a given remote selector return no series without client.Read.

findings.claim: Remote CostSamplingQueryable returns supported only if no configured queryables. A configured remote reader causes fanout sampling capability refusal, without removing ordinary series enumeration.
findings.limit: Primary and all other secondary capabilities can independently refuse sampling too.

findings.claim: Without sampler, every positive-series selector adds the same fallback annotation; effective interval remains supplied scrape interval and avgPointCost remains1.0 float unit. No-positive-series selector adds no such fallback in this branch.
findings.limit: Not physical I/O, true histogram sizes or real per-target scrape timing; estimator arithmetic, no measured accuracy.

findings.claim: Sampling unsupported errors fall back, but context canceled/deadline errors do not satisfy samplingUnsupported and remain errors through selected guards.

The global fallback annotation has identical error text; Annotations.Add uses that text as map key and Merge preserves key identity. Multiple fallback selectors therefore do not create one separately identifiable returned annotation each.
findings.documentation_disposition: Qualify existing wording warning for each selector: branch adds on each positive selector, but annotation set deduplicates the identical warning. Do not promise warning count or selector-specific identity.

remaining_unresolved: No remote server/client request executed; no actual config or network/data inspected.
No full remote-read transport, required-matchers, local/remote merge correctness or sample-accounting completeness audit.
Other docs on all duration statuses and all evaluator branches remain outside scope.
This is a selected-source review, not complete acceptance of three large existing documentation pages.
